summary: SF_WAINSCOT_PANEL_NC_v1 passes QA with 4 minor warnings and 0 blockers. All 6 pipeline files present (spec.json pending assembly). Cross-file threading validated: 25 TSK_ IDs in sop_modules match 25 rates in production. Single SF-based paintable item (ITM_WAINSCOT_PANEL). Combined prime+paint with primer conditional on substrate_state. 5 substrate-driven primer systems + 3 QT-driven finish systems, all reusing existing SYS_ IDs. Wainscot type complexity modifier correctly modeled. Sheen/QT gate compatible (QT3+satin default — no tension).

rule_1_tsk_sop_to_production.details: All 25 TSK_WNSC_* task IDs in sop_modules.json have matching entries in production.json.

rule_2_itm_in_variants.details: ITM_WAINSCOT_PANEL proposed. Verify in spec.json when assembled.

rule_3_sys_qt_match.details: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC→QT3, SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE→QT4, SYS_FF_PREMIUM→QT5 match resolution.json configuration_dimensions.

rule_4_inputs_consumed.details: All IN_ inputs from resolution.json are consumed by sop_modules tasks with matching paintscope_key references.

rule_5_ps_keys_match.details: All PS_ keys referenced in production/sop match resolution.json required_paintscope_inputs. PS_SURFACE_SF.WAINSCOTING is proposed (new key).

rule_6_zones_match.details: 2 zone_ids (floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent) match between resolution.json zone_ids and sop_modules protection_metadata.

rule_7_phase_order.details: Module sequence: setup(1) → prep(2) → prime(3) → finish(4) → interstage(5) → finish(6) → cleanup(7). Correct.

rule_8_uom_match.details: UOM consistent: wainscot tasks=SF, masking=LF, fixed tasks=FIXED in both sop_modules and production. No mismatches.

rule_9_tsk_prefix.details: All tasks use TSK_WNSC_ prefix per resolution.json context prefix WNSC.

rule_10_itm_ids.details: ITM_WAINSCOT_PANEL is proposed (new), correctly marked in resolution.

rule_11_enum_values.details: All enum values used across files match resolution.json applicable_enums. No prohibited values detected.

findings.details: run_rule states 'Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat'. run_count_formula = total_coats - 1.
Satin at QT3+, semi-gloss at QT4+, gloss at QT5 only. Default QT3+satin is compatible — no tension.
MOD_WNSC_PREP includes: fill fasteners, sand fill, caulk joints, caulk wall, sand prep, dust clean, MDF edge seal.
Quality tier differences expressed through scrutiny definitions in task notes, not simple multipliers.
Binary tasks for application/setup/cleanup; qt_scaled for inspection/sanding/repair/fill.
TSK_WNSC_FLOOR_PROTECT and TSK_WNSC_WALL_MASK have protection_metadata with action=setup.
All actions are valid: setup, teardown.
floor_perimeter and wall_adjacent are standard zone IDs.
floor_perimeter: TSK_WNSC_FLOOR_PROTECT (setup) ↔ TSK_WNSC_REMOVE_FLOOR_PROTECT (teardown). wall_adjacent: TSK_WNSC_WALL_MASK (setup) ↔ TSK_WNSC_REMOVE_WALL_MASK (teardown).

GEOM_NO_INTERNAL_COMPUTE.details: No internal geometry computation. SF from PaintScope input.

GEOM_INPUTS_DECLARED.details: 5 inputs declared: IN_SF_WAINSCOT, IN_EA_ROOMS_TOTAL, IN_SF_PROTECT_FLOOR_PERIMETER, IN_LF_WALL_ADJACENT, IN_SF_FLOOR_VACUUM_AREA.

UOM_RATE_MATCH.details: All production rates match task UOM. SF tasks have SF rates, LF tasks have LF rates, FIXED tasks have fixed_time_minutes.

ADJ_NO_GEOMETRY_DERIVATION.details: No LF↔SF derivation. Caulk rates expressed in SF/hr with noted LF/SF density ratios for documentation only — no runtime derivation.

FLOW_PAINTSCOPE_TO_SPEC_TO_ESTIMATION.details: Correct data flow: PaintScope → spec inputs → sop tasks → production rates.

PROD_MODIFIERS_INCREASE_TIME.details: wainscot_type modifier documented as 'effective_rate = base_rate ÷ modifier'. Correct time multiplier application.

PROD_SPRAY_BACKROLL_COUPLED.details: This spec does not use spray+backroll coupling. Spray and brush are separate application methods.

CLOSET_SHELVING_FLAG_REQUIRED.details: No closet shelving complexity in this spec.

doctrine_governance.notes: Inherited corrections RC-004 (no dry times), RC-005 (material systems are recommendations), RC-006 (correct product classification). All respected in materials.json and sop_modules.json.

missing_paintscope_keys.justification: Defined in Millwork Doctrine §1.1 but not yet in PaintScope catalog. Acknowledged as proposed — will need activation.

issues.description: Wainscot SF production rates are research estimates — no canonical doctrine provides wainscot-specific SF rates. Spray 175 SF/hr and brush 70 SF/hr derived from brief guidance and Millwork Doctrine §7.1 trim rates adapted for panel SF.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for field validation. Rates are reasonable estimates. Refine after field testing with production data.

issues.description: Beadboard modifier (1.15×) is interpolated between standard (1.0×) and complex (1.25×). Millwork Doctrine §7.2 does not explicitly define a beadboard category.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable interpolation. Field validation recommended. Consider updating Millwork Doctrine §7.2 to explicitly include beadboard category.

issues.description: Internal caulk joint density (~1.4 LF/SF for flat_panel) is a research estimate used to derive SF/hr caulk rate (50 SF/hr). No doctrine defines joint density for wainscot types.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for field validation. Rate appears reasonable for typical 4'×3' wainscot section geometry.

issues.description: Missing defect_tolerance definitions in production.json task entries. Critic doctrine recommends these for every task.
issues.suggested_fix: Add defect_tolerance definitions during human review phase. Not a blocker for v0.1.0 draft.

doctrine_compliance.millwork_nc_paint_doctrine: Compliant. MDF two-step prime (edge seal before latex). FJP stain-blocking mandatory. Hardwood tannin-blocking. Complexity modifiers from §7.2. SF-based measurement from §1.1.
doctrine_compliance.fine_finish_doctrine: Compliant. Combined prime+paint. Interstage at all QTs. Sanding discipline per tier. QT5 brush 3+ coats. Material systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC/MODIFIED_URETHANE/PREMIUM. Sheen/QT gate enforced.
doctrine_compliance.modifier_registry: Compliant. H1 for all wainscot (32-42 inches tall). QT modifiers on qt_scaled tasks only (QT3=1.0, QT4=1.3, QT5=1.5). wainscot_type modifier applied as time multiplier.
doctrine_compliance.protection_and_masking_doctrine: Compliant. Floor protection always. Wall masking spray-conditional. Both zones use existing IDs. Setup/teardown tasks paired.
doctrine_compliance.conventions: Compliant. CON_ prefix. task_classification. Severity values correct. Phase values correct. All units uppercase. No prohibited patterns.

key_characteristics: First spec with custom 'wainscot_type' configuration dimension (flat_panel/raised_panel/beadboard) driving complexity modifier
Single SF paintable item covering entire assembly (panels + internal rails/stiles + base rail)
Cap rail explicitly excluded — handled by SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT (ITM_TRIM_WAINSCOT_RAIL)
Three caulk joint types in prep: panel-to-rail, panel-to-stile, wainscot-to-wall
All 8 material system IDs reuse existing entries — no new SYS_ IDs needed (REUSE OVER CREATION)
QT3+satin default has no sheen/QT gate tension (unlike stair riser spec's QT3+semi-gloss tension)
